# DUB Agenda

> Mobile-first platform for premium barbershop appointment booking, integrated payments, and loyalty rewards.

DUB Agenda is a white-label scheduling and payment platform built for barbershops and their clients. It supports multi-tenant barbershop networks, real-time availability, PIX and wallet payments, subscription plans, and a points-based loyalty program.

## Pages

- [/](/): Landing page for returning clients and new visitors.
- [/escolher-barbearia](/escolher-barbearia): Discover nearby barbershops and select a preferred unit.
- [/b/:slug](/b/:slug): Public barbershop profile page with services, portfolio, and booking links.
